🔧 Spotify Configuration Fix Required

⚠️ Action Required
The production site needs the redirect URI added to Spotify app configuration

🚨 Quick Fix (5 minutes)

The Spotify authentication is failing because the production redirect URI is not whitelisted.

📋 Steps to Fix

  1. Go to Spotify Developer Dashboard
  2. Find app with Client ID: 67703322b3fe4c27aa42f10e3d067b84
  3. Click "Edit Settings"
  4. Add this redirect URI:
https://niels27.github.io/radio-zonder-reclame/callback.html
